title: Effects of a Nutrigenetic Diet on Fat Mass Loss, Insulin Resistance, and Subclinical Inflammation in Adults with Abdominal Obesity: A Randomized Controlled Trial-The INNUPREC Study.
snippet: Abdominal obesity (AO) is involved in the development of cardiometabolic disorders, in which factors such as diet and genetics play crucial roles.
